target.statement: SuperKMeans clustering build time (s) on the OpenAI dataset (999k vectors, 1536 dims, k=3997, 25 iterations) is 33.63 s vs FAISS 130.40 s, with matching recall@10/@100.

compute.basis: Requires building the C++/SIMD SuperKMeans code (with tuned BLAS), downloading ~6 GB OpenAI embeddings, and running 25-iteration k-means with k~4000 on 8 cores; absolute times will differ from the paper's 32-core Granite Rapids machine, so only the relative speedup is checkable.

blockers: Paper's absolute timings depend on a 32-core Intel Granite Rapids CPU with IntelMKL; a laptop will not reproduce the exact seconds
Code is research-grade C++ with SIMD/BLAS tuning; may need fixes to build on a laptop
OpenAI embedding dataset must be located/downloaded (public but not bundled)
title: A Super Fast K-means for Indexing Vector Embeddings
